name: keydoctor
description: Key Doctor On Call: NEAR access-key health checks and DAO proposal alerts

scripts.deploy:dashboard: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; : "${KD_WORKER_URL:?set KD_WORKER_URL in .env}" && pnpm --filter dashboard test && pnpm --filter dashboard build && pnpm --filter worker exec wrangler pages deploy ../dashboard/dist --project-name "${KD_PAGES_PROJECT:-key-doctor-dashboard}" --branch main
scripts.deploy:worker: pnpm --filter worker test && pnpm --filter worker run deploy
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm test && pnpm deploy:dashboard && pnpm deploy:worker
